questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An intersection is coming up. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A bent left arm pointing upward is a hand signal for a right turn or right lane change. You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: A merge is ahead. Two lanes of traffic going the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a divided highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Then you may go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: A sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic can flow on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules. This sign means you should drive in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left. Riders use hand signals instead of or in addition to mechanical turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right. This is a hand signal used instead of mechanical turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a full stop at a stop sign. Yield the right-of-way to vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down when approaching an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from the right side is merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive in that direction. It is not safe to enter from where you are. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.
